prohibited: bootstrap generation, significance testing, or new confidence intervals
SHAP, LIME, IG, feature-importance, or feature-analysis recomputation
new prevalence, LOAO, seed, metric, average, composite score, or qualitative cutoff computation
new hypotheses, datasets, architectures, or unsupported reinterpretations
large_binary_policy: Models, checkpoints and scientific probability arrays may be referenced or byte-hashed only; they may not be deserialized.
violation_policy: Stop synthesis and record the blocked operation rather than approximating or substituting evidence.
